maya: Heads-up for a tight cutover in 15m. We're doing a header swap + kernel tweak. api/runtime/console/router please confirm fallbacks and roll criteria.
jon: runtime ack. kernel-15 queued for canary. warmup script kicking off against preprod; will monitor GC and RSS.
liam: console ack. freezing UI pushes and disabling analytics flush during canary to reduce noise.
kate: api ack. will gate via X-Rdwd-Route; pin old endpoint v2.4.9 as immediate rollback.
ravi: router ack. plan: shadow 10% for 4m -> shift 20% every 4m. auto-hold on 5xx >0.25%/1m.
anjali: SRE here. added rapid-fire alerts for p99 regressions and 4xx/5xx drift. pager: anjali, jon.
maya: Deploybot, schedule canary: 1% -> 10% after 3m -> 50% after 12m -> 100% after 30m. Abort on rollback triggers.
deploybot: Deploy created: api:v2.6.0, runtime:kernel-15, console:static-2026-03-23d, router:hdr-swap-v3. Plan: /deploy/7323456789
jon: note: kernel-15 changes batching window; expect transient p99 jitter for ~90s. watch tailing latency and kv cache warm.
liam: adding lightweight banner for internal users and support link to reduce noise.
maya: Proposed rollback triggers: 1) p99 > 2x baseline for 3m, 2) error rate > 0.7% sustained 2m, 3) schema mismatch errors >0.2% in API -> immediate rollback.
kate: Add quick debug hook: capture 50 failed traces to s3 prefix deploy-7323456789/fails for triage.
ravi: router will auto-hold at 10% if backend 5xx >0.3% over 1m. manual override at /ops/router/hold. Will also route an adjacency fallback to api:v2.4.9 if needed.
anjali: telemetry: enable 2x trace sampling for the first 10m and enable KV miss logs for runtime.
maya: thumbs? react with :thumbsup: if ready and fallbacks available.
jon: :thumbsup:
liam: :thumbsup:
kate: :thumbsup:
ravi: :thumbsup:
maya: launching warmup in 5m. keep comms in this thread only; paste deploybot logs here and short status updates. If anyone needs escalation, ping on-call first then post here.
